id: title:gesh:dash the in progress bucket on a tool s report

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a visual indicator (dashed sparkline) to charts when the final time bucket is still collecting, preventing misinterpretation of incomplete data as a decline.
review.reason: Adds an optional prop `incompleteTail` and its associated rendering logic to the `StatTiles` and `Sparkline` components. This allows the chart to visually distinguish the current, incomplete time bucket from completed ones, preventing the sparkline from drawing a solid line that could imply a completed decline. The change is localized to the frontend visualization layer.
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned based on the observed implementation of a specific UI behavior. No evidence exists regarding actual user benefit, adoption, or prevention of incidents. The tier is conservative, treating this as a bounded, localized behavior correction rather than a systemic improvement.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional prop `incompleteTail` to the `StatTiles` component, its parent, and the `MetricTile` component, and passes it through the rendering chain.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the chart to receive a signal that the current time bucket is still collecting, without changing the underlying data or query.

observations.behavior: Adds a JSDoc comment and the `incompleteTail` prop to the `StatTiles` component, explaining that it marks the final bucket as an in-progress interval and prevents the sparkline from reading a partial period as a decline.
observations.code_quote: // When true, the final bucket is the current in-progress interval — dash the sparkline from
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the purpose of the prop for future maintainers and consumers of this component.

observations.behavior: Passes the `incompleteTail` prop to the `Sparkline` component, using it to set `sparklineDashedFromIndex` to the last label index when true, otherwise undefined.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the in-progress signal to the sparkline rendering, enabling the dashed-line behavior.
